title: feat(security): re-open a dismissed or revoked suggested audience binding

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgKURKuRGF1ewEVVZKx7U1i4)_
Fixes #27149

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 访问设置里「推荐绑定」被忽略或撤销后，管理员现在可以把它重新打开，回到待定状态，再按原流程接受。
- 为什么改：之前点错一次「忽略」或「撤销」就无法在产品里反悔，只能手改 everyone 定义。
- 风险与回滚：重新打开只把记录改回待定，不授予任何权限；接受仍要走原来的高风险检查。回滚即撤掉这一个 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/suggested-audience-bindings.ts`（reopen 函数）、`packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts`（新增可选成员）、`packages/rest/src/security-routes.ts`（第二个线上入口）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/suggested-audience-bindings.test.ts`，应看到 reopen 一组 5 条用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（spec 契约成员按 triage 的跨域例外裁决处理）。

## What changes

A dismissed audience-binding suggestion (a declined one, or a revoked acceptance) was terminal: `confirmAudienceBindingSuggestion` accepts only pending rows, and `syncAudienceBindingSuggestions` never moves a dismissed row. This adds one door that takes the "no" back.

- **`POST /api/v1/security/suggested-bindings/:id/reopen`** moves a `dismissed` row to `pending`, writing exactly what the sync's own re-open arm writes (`deployment_decision: false`, `resolved_by` / `resolved_at` null). The row then reads, and is reconciled, as a suggestion never answered.
- **It is not an implicit accept** (triage ruling on #27149). A pending row is not an input of `readAcceptedEveryoneSets`, so nothing is re-derived: a revoked set stays out of the `everyone` definition until the existing confirm accepts it again, with ADR-0090 D7's high-risk gate.
- **Refusals**, all before any write: the deployment authority as for dismiss (`403`); the walled-host refusal naming `acceptedDefaultPermissionSets` and the no-record-owner refusal (`409`); unknown id (`404`); a row that is not `dismissed` (`409 SUGGESTION_STATE`, the message names its status); a set its package no longer suggests (`409`). The last one keeps the decision on record: re-opened, such a row would be pruned by the next sync.
- **Contract**: `ISecurityService` gains the OPTIONAL `reopenAudienceBindingSuggestion(callerContext, id)`. Optional so an existing implementer still satisfies the contract; absence is a defined state (every dismissal stands, nothing granted). Both mounts feature-detect it and answer `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` naming the door.
- **Both mounts** serve the route, as for confirm/dismiss: `packages/rest/src/security-routes.ts` (RouteManager) and `packages/runtime/src/domains/security.ts` (dispatcher). Rows added to both route ledgers (`disposition: 'sdk'`), and the SDK gains `client.security.suggestedBindings.reopen(id)`.
- `confirm` and `reopen` share one helper for the "is the set still suggested by this package" check (`requireStillSuggested`); confirm's messages are unchanged except the verb slot.
- Generated/census rows: the tenant-audit census page and counts file (one new write call site: 244 → 245, with its prose figures), and the runtime route-ledger census sentence (105 → 106 rows).
- Docs: `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx` lists the door and what re-opening does.

## Tests

- plugin-security `suggested-audience-bindings.test.ts`, new `reopenAudienceBindingSuggestion` block: dismiss → re-open → pending, listed as pending by the list (which reconciles first, and does not undo it), then accepted through the existing confirm; revoke → re-open grants nothing (definition, re-derive, sync and `readAcceptedEveryoneSets` all agree); the re-accept still runs the high-risk gate (403); pending, accepted and observed rows refused by name (409, nothing written); unknown id 404; a no-longer-suggested dismissal refused and kept as history. Authority and walled-host cases extended to reopen.
- spec contract test: reopen is optional (the unguarded call does not compile) and a served member answers.
- plugin-security members pin: reopen declared `optional`.
- runtime: dispatcher reopen passes the caller context and id, 501 when the member is absent, 409 mapping; anonymous deny covers reopen.
- rest: envelope family extended to reopen (501 not registered, 501 member absent, typed 403/404/409, untyped 500 `INTERNAL_ERROR`, one skeleton, 200 success); write-route ledgers carry the row.
- client: `reopen` POSTs to the encoded id subroute.

## Acceptance notes

- File surface (cross-domain exception, triage comment 6484879688; seat claim 6485403386): the spec face is exactly one OPTIONAL `ISecurityService` member and its contract-test pin. Files beyond the claim's literal list, each required by a gate or pinning a touched door, cleared by the seat before push: runtime `http-dispatcher.test.ts` and `domains/security-anonymous-deny-ordering.test.ts`; rest `security-suggested-bindings-envelope.test.ts`, `rest-write-route-hook-refusal-sentence.ledger.test.ts` and `rest-write-response-internal-fields.tripwire.test.ts` (the last two enumerate every write route); client `admin-surfaces.test.ts`; `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx` and `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md` (regenerated by `scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write`, because `check-tenant-audit-census` reds on the new write call site, plus its prose figures).

- The untyped-fault terminal of the REST reopen route is the standard `INTERNAL_ERROR` rather than a family code `SUGGESTION_REOPEN_FAILED`: registering a family code is an edit to the spec error-code ledger and its generated JSON schemas, beyond the one contract member. If the spec seat prefers family symmetry, that is a small follow-up.
- The Studio control (a re-grant button in the suggestions panel) is the ui follow-up #26846 left out; this PR builds the server door only.

- Build: full `turbo run build` after the rebase, 116/116 tasks, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Typecheck (`tsc --noEmit` + `check:test-typecheck`) of spec, plugin-security, runtime, rest and client: green (pre-rebase tree; the rebase brought one cli-only commit).
- Full test suites of the five packages: green on the pre-rebase tree (748 + 236 + 334 + 468 + 52 files, 0 failures). Targeted suites re-run on this head: spec contract 26/26, plugin-security 58/58, runtime 315/315, rest 640/640, client 8/8.
- Ablation (once, then restored): reopen's write changed to `status: 'confirmed', deployment_decision: true` (an implicit accept) via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `014d57b4cf14` to `121c7e0c7aca`): 3 reopen cases red (dismiss-then-accept, revoke grants nothing, re-accept runs the gate). Restored with `git checkout HEAD`; the file's blob equals the HEAD blob `014d57b4cf14`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
